title: Double boiler for VERY SMALL jobs but leaves an air space between my smallest pot rim and the boiler
text:
Double boiler for VERY SMALL jobs but leaves an air space between my smallest pot rim and the boiler. I sometimes use a small double boiler to melt chocolate, sugar (for caramel), or butter. Previously I use to use a small yet heavy Pyrex bowl over one of my pots. What I like about his one is that it is light, has two pour spouts, and a long handle that stays cool to the touch. It makes it easier for me to carry and pour out the contents. It's also very sturdy and the handle stays cool to the touch.

The only reason I rated this 3 stars is because I am unable to find a pot that fits this with a tight seal. Normally a double boiler requires that a tight seal be made between the water and the boiler; however, on every single pot I tried there is a 1/4" to 1/2" gap between the rim of the pot and this double boiler making it take longer for me to melt butter, sugar, and chocolate. If I could find a pot that this snugly fits the rim of, I would have rated this 5 stars.

UPDATE - I purchased the [[ASIN:B003L0ZNVW Calphalon Tri-Ply Stainless Steel 1-Quart Open Sauce Pan]] from Home Goods for $19.99 plus tax. This double boiler comes close to creating a snug fit with this pot. I've tried many other pots and have taken some back and this is the best fit I can find. There's still about 1/8th" of space around the rim so it's not a tight seal. See attached picture.
